cc:Work.dc:title: query_ratios_action
cc:Work.dc:description: Cells show geometric means of ten paired block query ratios for CPU Polars 2.0.0 / GPU, using the action endpoint. Color encodes log2(ratio), centered symmetrically on 1×. These query comparisons are descriptive; no query significance tests or multiplicity-adjusted query claims are made. Gray N/A cells retain the original strict GPU regex and grouped-window rejections. They are not a ratio of 1 and receive no imputed latency. The original correlated query does not establish an executed nonempty anti join.
